messages.subject: WC-00130 - engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Please find attached our engagement letter for the Hartnell matter (our ref WC-00130). As noted, our estimate for advising on and negotiating a settlement is £18,000-£26,000 plus VAT, with a separate estimate if the Tribunal claim is defended.

Grateful if you could return a signed copy at your convenience. We'll proceed in the meantime.

Kind regards,
Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T: 020 7946 0021
